question: If a coin is tossed three times, what is the probability that at least two heads show up? Next, if the experiment is repeated 10 times (that is, 10 sets of 3 tosses each), what is the expected number of times at least two heads will occur? (c) If at least two heads are observed in exactly 8 out of the 10 experiments, what is the probability all 3 tosses in those 8 cases were heads?
